changes: First release: static CRM (companies, people, deals, pipelines, activities, tasks, custom objects and fields, views, automations, lead forms, reports) with an admin that runs entirely in the browser.
Data on storage you own: encrypted journal on S3-compatible buckets, private GitHub / GitLab repos or a local folder; git-json and Firebase backends.
agentcrm CLI: install from a plan, doctor, deploy-admin, records / schema / pipelines / views / users / settings, CSV import and export, reports, automations, forms, compaction (GDPR erasure).
MCP server (agentcrm mcp) exposing the AI tool catalog, schema / pipeline resources and sales prompts.
Claude Code plugin with four skills (install, manage, admin, sales) and generated Hermes Agent skills.
